title: Critical Liouville Energies and Zeta-Zero Detection
description: The complete manuscript adds explicit Euler-factor bounds and a quantitative theorem showing that completely multiplicative functions can match any prescribed finite normalized Abel jet to arbitrary accuracy while retaining a pole beyond one half and violating the critical local-energy estimate. It supplies an exact rational example with cutoff 2^320. The required upper bound for the actual Liouville function, RH and GRH remain unproved.
